official: 東京都国民健康保険事業費納付金条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 提出議案と議決結果

name: 国保の子育て支援分の納付金算定を定める
summary: 現在の条例には、子ども・子育て支援納付金に係る納付金の所得係数や割合を定めた条文はありません。この議案では、所得係数の決め方と、所得や被保険者数などに関する割合を定めます。令和8年4月1日に施行します。
changes: 所得係数を、政令に定める金額の比率を基に知事が定める数とする
所得などに関する割合を政令に定める数とする
被保険者数などに関する割合を政令に定める数とする
why: 国の政令改正を受け、子ども・子育て支援納付金に係る納付金の徴収に必要な事項を定めるためと、都は説明しています。

en.name: Sets how to calculate child-rearing support contributions for National Health Insurance
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Tokyo Metropolitan Government National Health Insurance Business Expenses Contribution Ordinance
en.summary: The current ordinance does not specify the income coefficient or the ratios used to calculate contributions related to the Children and Child-Rearing Support Contribution. This bill sets how the income coefficient is determined and sets ratios relating to income and the number of insured people, among other things. It takes effect on April 1, 2026.
changes: Sets the income coefficient as a figure determined by the governor based on the ratio of amounts prescribed by Cabinet Order
Sets the ratio relating to income and other factors at the figure prescribed by Cabinet Order
Sets the ratio relating to the number of insured people and other factors at the figure prescribed by Cabinet Order
en.why: The Tokyo Metropolitan Government says this is to establish the matters needed to collect contributions related to the Children and Child-Rearing Support Contribution, following an amendment to a Cabinet Order.
